name: A Nova Moment
source:
A short visual novel about Ellie, a curious blogger and  Xanthus, an alien looking for his son.

[From [url=https://hulmine.itch.io/a-nova-moment]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部短篇視覺小說，講述充滿好奇心的部落客艾莉，以及正在尋找兒子的外星人贊瑟斯的故事。
